Santa Maria Maior — Lisbon, Portugal

🟡 Local press research

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Covers Baixa, Chiado, Alfama, Castelo, Mouraria and Martim Moniz. By day, the historic core is a long-running pickpocketing hotspot for tourists, with repeated reports of wallet-theft rings around Alfama's viewpoints, the Baixa grid and the trams, and PSP still making frequent arrests (six Romanian pickpockets detained in a single 24-hour period, July 2025). By night the picture is more serious: Rua do Benformoso and Rua da Amendoeira in Mouraria host an open-air drug market police describe as serving '50 to 60 customers an hour' from noon to 2am, and Martim Moniz has seen a stabbing brawl that injured seven people (January 2025), an alleged rape that alarmed residents, and a contested PSP crackdown operation. Sources checked: Jornal SOL, 23 Apr 2026 – "Mouraria. A 'crackolândia' de Lisboa"; Folha Nacional, 17 Jan 2025 – "Nova rixa no Martim Moniz acaba com facadas e sangue na rua"; Observador, 28 Jan 2025 – "Operação policial no Martim Moniz divide plenário da Assembleia Municipal de Lisboa"; Observador (special report) – "Violação no Martim Moniz. Moradores preocupados com falta de segurança pedem mais câmaras e mais polícias"; Público, 12 Jan 2018 – "Vaga de assaltos a turistas atinge a zona histórica de Lisboa"; Jornal de Notícias – "Turistas a saque em miradouros de Alfama"; Público, 17 Jul 2025 – "Seis carteiristas romenas detidas em 24 horas em Lisboa".
